task: Fix GHE GitHub integrations by propagating base_url=https://{ghe_hostname}/api/v3 through all Github()/GithubIntegration() constructor sites, adding a normalization helper, and preserving backward compat for github.com URLs.

key_reasoning.reason: 11 changed files (5 production: custom_github_api_wrapper.py, github_client.py, git_api_service.py, git_auth_utils.py, git_loader.py + utils.py; 5 test files across matching paths). Guide places 11–15 files at XL (5). The high test count reflects thorough TDD coverage rather than production complexity.

Change spans 4 distinct subsystems: codemie_tools/git/github (wrapper + normalization helper), codemie_tools/core/vcs/github (GithubClient), codemie/service/git_api (GitApiService), and codemie/datasource/loader (git_loader + git_auth_utils). Each is a separate package boundary requiring independent changes to propagate the base_url parameter.

Base score M (3): URL normalization has non-trivial edge cases (CR-001 port preservation, CR-002 bare-URL urlparse) confirmed by two code-review fix-up commits. Red flag applied: affects GitHub App token generation and PAT auth flows throughout, bumping to L (4). Backward compat contract (github.com/api.github.com must NOT pass base_url) adds risk of silent regression.

Touches Service layer (git_api_service.py, git_auth_utils.py), Agent-Tool layer (custom_github_api_wrapper.py, utils.py/GitCredentials), Datasource/Loader layer (git_loader.py), and External layer (PyGithub/GHE endpoint). Three meaningful architectural layers — no DB schema, no UI, no infra changes — maps to M (3).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped M (3) → L (4): change affects GitHub authentication flows (GitHub App token generation and PAT auth) across all constructor call sites
